name: ipdock
description: Dynamic DNS for self-hosters. ipdock automatically keeps your hostname updated whenever your public IP changes — no scripts, no cron jobs, no config files. Just run the container with your token and you're done. Free tier includes 3 dynamic hostnames with DNSSEC, custom domain support, and a DynDNS-compatible update endpoint. Get your token at https://ipdock.io

variables.name: IPDOCK_TOKEN
variables.description: Your ipdock API token. Get yours at https://ipdock.io after creating a hostname.

variables.name: IPDOCK_HOSTNAME
variables.description: Optional: Override the hostname to update (e.g. myserver.ipdock.io). If unset, the token's assigned hostname is used.

variables.name: IPDOCK_INTERVAL
variables.description: How often to check and update your IP, in seconds. Default: 300 (5 minutes).

variables.name: IPDOCK_API_URL
variables.description: ipdock API base URL. Leave as default unless self-hosting.
